facts.fact: 记忆一（新奥尔良祖母葬礼）：年轻的 Atalanthya 与妹妹并排躺在摇椅上——她对 Emerson 视而不见（记忆不可见）；妹妹容貌未变，Atalanthya 却年轻得多。
facts.anchor: Atalanthya Moon and her sister reclined side-by-side in rickety rocking chairs.

facts.fact: Aeloria 自述：Iris 是唯一不顾她「与家族的差异」仍给她一点尊重与爱的女人。
facts.anchor: Of course I came to pay my respects to the only woman who ever offered me a crumb of respect and love

facts.fact: 关键因果：Aeloria 是 Iris 离开图书馆的原因；她自认是「Moon 家族的脏秘密」，眼看着唯一支持她的人离开图书馆后枯萎凋零。
facts.anchor: I am the reason she left the Library.

facts.fact: 姐妹账本：父母当年想囚禁她以保家族 legacy，Atalanthya 确实护过她——但也利用了她。
facts.anchor: “You protected me when our parents wanted to imprison me to keep the family’s legacy intact,” Aeloria replied. “But you also used me.”

facts.fact: 最重指控：Iris 上位时，Atalanthya 召唤的正是 Aeloria——复活 Archivists 的人是她；Atalanthya 对此沉默。
facts.anchor: it was me who you called upon to resurrect the Archivists.

facts.fact: Aeloria 的立场：不效忠 Central Library、Foundation 或 Catalogue——只忠于姐姐；至于 Catalogue 及其遗产，烧了也无所谓。
facts.anchor: As far as I’m concerned…the Catalogue, its Libraries, and its legacy can burn.

facts.fact: 记忆二（鸡尾酒廊）：年轻 Iris 的招揽演说——中央图书馆把几代 Librarian 驯化成爱上为奴的羊群；她要自由、要罪（I want freedom. I want sin.）。
facts.anchor: They have turned entire generations of Librarians into a herd of sheep who will grow up to love their servitude and never dream of revolution.

facts.fact: Aeloria 的回绝：你满心是毒、为权力口吐白沫——你眼里的人不是士兵就是障碍；我不会成为你圣战的下一个伤亡。
facts.anchor: I will not become the next casualty in your crusade.

facts.fact: 现今 Dilethisante 之所以是那副废墟死城模样：Iris 被拒后毁掉她建在此地的圣所，把这个世界交给了年轻侍者 Deacon Prior——正是今天自称牧羊人的 Reverend。
facts.anchor: she destroyed the sanctuary I built here and handed this world over to Deacon Prior.

facts.fact: 结盟问答：她给出「两个理由」（纹路证明你比母亲好 + Adrien 跟来了）后只承诺「我今天不杀你」——忠诚仍在 Atalanthya，战争来时未必不同边。
facts.anchor: “It means I will not kill you today,” Aeloria said.
